dishes.name: MEAT SAMPLER
dishes.description: A TIBS combination plate of lamb, chicken and Filet Mignon and your choice of any and 2 VEGAN sides

dishes.name: Tibs
dishes.description:
SIGNATURE ENTREE
Tender cubes of meat sautéed with tomatoes, onions, jalapeños, and Ethiopian spiced butter, served with your choice of injera, pita, or rice and one vegan side of your choice.

dishes.name: Ethiopian Spiced Iced Tea
dishes.description: A traditional tea infused with cloves, cinnamon, and fresh ginger. Served iced, this aromatic blend is both soothing and invigorating — a taste of Ethiopian hospitality in a glass.

dishes.name: Bottled Water
dishes.description: Still, bottled water served cold. A simple and clean refreshment to accompany your meal.

dishes.name: Iced Mint Green Tea
dishes.description: Chilled green tea steeped with fresh mint leaves and lightly sweetened. A revitalizing and fragrant drink that pairs well with spiced dishes.

dishes.name: Soft Drinks
dishes.description: Choose from popular favorites: Sprite, Coke or Diet Coke. A classic addition to your meal for a burst of familiar fizz.

dishes.name: Pomé
dishes.description: A house-made pomegranate lemonade that blends tart pomegranate juice with sweet lemon and cane sugar for a tangy and invigorating refreshment.

dishes.name: Perrier
dishes.description: A refreshing bottle of sparkling natural mineral water, imported from France. Crisp and effervescent, it’s the perfect palate cleanser between bites.

dishes.name: COMBO PLATES
dishes.description: Each combo is served with your choice of injera, pita or rice perfect for soaking up every delicious bite.

dishes.name: Tikil Gomen (Cabbage)
dishes.description: Cabbage and potatoes slow-cooked with carrots in a mildly spiced turmeric sauce. This comforting stew is flavorful without being overpowering, ideal for those who enjoy lighter, savory notes.

dishes.name: Fasolia
dishes.description: Green beans and carrots braised in a berbere-infused sauce with caramelized onions, garlic, and ginger. This dish is a vibrant mix of textures and tastes, balancing sweet and spicy in every bite.

dishes.name: Eggplant Wot
dishes.description: Roasted eggplant gently sautéed with garlic and caramelized onions in a lightly spiced berbere sauce. Creamy in texture and bursting with rich, smoky flavors, this vegan delight is full of character.

dishes.name: Kay Sir
dishes.description: A vibrant and hearty mix of red beets and potatoes cooked until fork-tender. Kay Sir is lightly seasoned and naturally sweet, bringing a colorful balance to your vegan platter.

dishes.name: Gomen (Collard Greens)
dishes.description: Tender collard greens sautéed in a blend of garlic, onions, and a subtle spice mix. Gomen offers a deliciously mild and savory flavor, making it a refreshing and nourishing accompaniment to any plate.

dishes.name: Ater (Yellow Split Pea Stew)
dishes.description: Mild and comforting, this dish of split yellow peas is stewed in a garlic, onion and turmeric base for a light, earthy flavor profile. Ater Kik is a beloved staple in Ethiopian vegan cuisine and pairs beautifully with injera.

dishes.name: Shekla Shiro (Chickpea Stew)
dishes.description: A comforting stew made from ground chickpeas, slow-cooked with berbere, garlic, onions and Ethiopian spices. Thick, rich, and deeply flavorful, Shekla Shiro is one of Ethiopia’s most iconic vegan dishes, often served bubbling hot in a traditional clay pot.

dishes.name: Miser (Spicy Split Red Lentil Stew)
dishes.description: Red lentils simmered until tender in a bold berbere sauce with sautéed onions, garlic, and ginger. This spicy, earthy dish offers a warming depth and is a must-have for fans of Ethiopian comfort food.

dishes.name: Sambusa
dishes.description: Golden, crispy pastry pockets stuffed with your choice of savory seasoned chicken or hearty lentils. Our sambusas are handmade and deep-fried to perfection, offering a satisfying crunch with every bite. A classic appetizer beloved across East Africa.

dishes.name: Aukri
dishes.description: A deliciously creamy soybean dip blended with a hint of Ethiopian spice, served with soft, warm pita bread. Perfectly balanced in flavor and texture, this hearty starter is both nutritious and satisfying — a great way to begin your Ethiopian meal experience.
